data.name: Akshaj
data.long_meaning: The name Akshaj is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Aksh' which means 'Eye' and 'J' which means 'Immortal'. In Hindu mythology, Akshaj is believed to represent the imperishable and indestructible divine eye that bestows wisdom and knowledge. The name is also associated with Lord Shiva, who is revered as the destroyer and the protector.
